create_mutox_config: create a MutoxConfig dataclass instance with a specified input embedding size
build_mutox_config_registry: build a MutoxConfig registry entry using ConfigRegistrar with a DependencyContainer
register_mutox_configs: register mutox classifier configurations into a fairseq2 dependency container
use_mutox_family_constant: use the MUTOX_FAMILY constant to identify the mutox_classifier model family
configure_base_mutox: configure the base mutox model with a 1024-dimensional input embedding size
